name: The Oaks
summary: Refined, indoor-outdoor mall with Nordstrom, Sephora & other popular chains, plus dining & a cinema.
description: Step into The Oaks Shopping Center where sumptuous luxury dances gracefully with timeless elegance, offering an inviting environment where community and lifestyle come together. Located in Thousand Oaks, the center features an array of shopping, dining, and entertainment including AMC Theatres, with each detail meticulously designed to awaken an exquisite sense of refined opulence.
demographics: The Oaks Shopping Center serves the affluent Thousand Oaks community and broader Conejo Valley, attracting primarily upper-middle-class families and professionals with household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area comprises educated suburban residents aged 30-65 who value quality retailers and family-friendly amenities, including the center's community-focused programs like Acorns for Education supporting 15 local schools. Shoppers demonstrate preferences for a mix of national retailers, sit-down dining experiences, and entertainment options, with strong weekday traffic from local residents and weekend visitors from surrounding areas.
